result.title: Agent World Model in the Wild: Computer-Use Agent Environment Synthesis
result.summary: Agent learning is shifting from learning from human data toward learning through interaction with the world. However, scaling such learning directly in real-world computer systems is challenging and can introduce substantial security risks. We therefore propose Agent World Model in the Wild (WildAWM), a scalable pipeline for synthesizing controllable environments and tasks for training general computer-use agents (CUAs). Whereas existing approaches typically specialize in a single agent interaction interface, we construct executable environments that jointly support graphical user interfaces, model context protocol services, and command-line interfaces, allowing agents to flexibly combine visual interaction, tool use, and code execution. WildAWM is entirely powered by open-source models, demonstrating that high-quality computer-use environments can be generated without proprietary frontier models. Beyond environments, we address three recurring challenges in task synthesis: ensuring solvability, maintaining sufficient difficulty, and producing reliable verifiers, by introducing execution-based quality gates that combine heterogeneous agent rollouts, cross-judge consistency checks, and counterfactual probes of judgment robustness. The resulting pipeline synthesizes 341 long-horizon environment-task pairs that can require over 100 agent steps to solve and remain challenging even for frontier models, with GPT-6-Astra solving only 60% of them. We train two Qwen models of different sizes exclusively in these synthetic worlds. Both models achieve substantial gains across 8 out-of-distribution benchmarks spanning web, claw, and computer-use agents, demonstrating that learning in WildAWM's synthesized worlds generalizes broadly to unseen computer-use tasks. The code is publicly available at https://github.com/MSR-Orchard/WildAWM.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 WildAWM，用开源模型合成可执行的计算机使用环境与任务，联合支持 GUI、MCP 服务与命令行接口，并用执行式质量门（多智能体 rollout、交叉评审、反事实探测）保证可解性、难度与验证可靠性，据此合成 341 个长程环境-任务对并训练 Qwen 模型，在 8 个分布外基准上取得提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 不直接研究视觉 latent 推理或推理期状态生成，但其执行式质量门与反事实探测可能为 LVR 轨迹训练中的验证可靠性、监督信号与贡献分配提供可核查的方法线索。
